description.value: A municipal aquatic centre in Surrey's Grandview Heights neighbourhood, operated by the City of Surrey. The facility features a swimming pool with a family hot tub and a weight room, open for drop-in use. Touring cyclists passing through south Surrey may appreciate the chance to take a refreshing swim and stretch out in the weight room.
